title: Peruvian-Style Grilled Fish Ceviche
description: A refreshing twist on traditional ceviche, featuring grilled fish marinated in Peruvian-inspired flavors.

ingredients.name: Peruvian ceviche marinade
ingredients.notes: Made with aji amarillo peppers, garlic, and lime juice

instructions: Season fish with salt and pepper. Grill for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
In a large bowl, combine marinated fish, aji amarillo peppers, cilantro, and lime juice.
Stir in olive oil and adjust seasoning as needed.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Serve chilled, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
